network_scope: Cold first-view request payloads from Safari on the same desktop viewport, using two local production-build snapshots with gzip enabled. No scrolling before the snapshot. Includes favicon requests; does not measure internet latency, LCP, INP or CLS.

hero_compute_benchmark.scope: Node rendering-logic only; no-op canvas excludes actual browser painting. 80 frames after 20-frame warmup; same 7680 faces.
